Lots of 'solada' noise is Portuguese football slang; DM-solicitation spam (@iSolCryptoo, @Theana174, @realmarc9, @Monerocrypto_, @JouriAlia, @SolanaGurupnl) replies to @DustBunnyada - ignored. Most launches have <30 holders and volume multiples of mcap = churn. Skipped: BEAST (36h, ~17.7k ADA mcap, vol 4x mcap, 63 holders, -21%): Pass. PCOCK, BABYBOLT, VOLT, DBUN, MILK and other <2h launches: Pass/pure lottery (<30 holders, copycats). CORE (mascot, 142h, ~61.9k ADA mcap, 99 holders, -21%): Pass, stale.
